hypothesis: Within the same fixed N8 top-100 candidate pool, query-conditioned marginal reasoning-set utility learning using only deployable query-to-history and redundancy features can beat the frozen-style N8 RRF ranking at Top-10.

method.name: N11 query-conditioned marginal reasoning-set utility selector
method.model_input: query case_prompt; case and masked-reasoning historical library; selected-case similarities; no true query utility

evaluation.predeclared_primary_comparison: N11_SET_HGB vs N8_RRF on 360 disjoint E084 outer meta PMCID groups

governance.selection_scope: exploratory train-internal holdout only, not independent external
governance.decision_rule: Both primary and char delta positive with lower CI >0 supports candidature for new external cohort; otherwise archive and do not re-fit same group.
